units.source_text: 看见无数流萤到处乱飞，便想起古诗中“夕殿萤飞思悄然”之句，低声吟诵。

en.t: Seeing countless fireflies darting about everywhere, he remembered the line from an old poem, "In the evening palace, fireflies fly and thoughts grow quietly sorrowful," and recited it softly.

units.source_text: 此时他所吟的，无非是悼亡之诗。

en.t: What he was reciting then was nothing other than a poem mourning the dead.
